summary: A shadow Cognition session is now bounded by rounds, tokens and time only, never per tool, each at least 10 times a tag turn's.
details: The per-tool, memory and pass-wide call ceilings and the repeat veto are gone for the session; every other pass and the tag path keep theirs.

`[dreamer.budgets.cognition]` now defaults to 200 turns, 10,240,000 total tokens, 120,000 output tokens and 3600 s, and a block that still sets `max_memory_calls`, `max_tool_calls` or a `tool_calls` table refuses to load.
`[cognition] session_timeout_seconds` defaults to 3900 so the wake outlives the session.
limitations: The session mode ships off, so nothing changes until an operator turns shadow sessions on.
